title: Simply recommended
text: It was a great sailing trip with our skipper Luis from Venezuela. 😊 The drink and food service was super. 👍🏽 His music was a dream. I was very happy with the music mix from Luis. 💚 Wonderful weather, for a wonderful excursion and for me the end to a week in Barca. 🌞 With little sun, but with a lot to see. 😍
author: Tabea_S

title: Sunset
text: Relaxing trip! Such beautiful views. Violetta very friendly and accomodating. She stopped to let anyone who wanted to swim jump in.  The water was incredible.
author: Amy_A

title: Beautiful Cruise!
text: Such a great way to end a wonderful 2 weeks in Spain! Violette was our captain and she was amazing! She was friendly and made sure we were comfortable and always had a drink! The views were spectacular and it was so peaceful being out on the water. I would book this again!
author: cathleenc370

title: Beautiful Sunset Cruise
text: An absolutely wonderful end to my two week trip to Spain! Violette was a great host! She kept our glasses filled and pointed out the sites in Barcelona. The sunset was stunning and the whole experience was peaceful and chill. I enjoyed getting to talk with the other guests and simply relaxing on the boat. Great experience overall! I would definitely do this again!
